snow_ratio_model: trained on 3185 hand-measured Sierra and Colorado snow days at 86 stations, 2021 to 2026
powder_formula: 10 x (1 - exp(-new snow / 6 in)): 6 in gives 6.3, 12 in gives 8.6, 18 in gives 9.5.
0.55 at a snow ratio of 6:1 or less, rising to 1.0 at 12:1, flat to 20:1, 0.95 above.
1.0 up to 15 mph ridge wind during and 12 h after the snow, falling to 0.6 at 45 mph.
1.05 when the snow gets lighter through the storm (ratio up by 2 or more), 0.93 when it gets heavier by 2 or more, else 1.0.
1 - 0.6 x the share of the storm's water that fell as rain here, then x 0.6 if 2 mm or more of rain fell in the last 6 h.
0.95 + 0.10 x the share of the snow that fell overnight, between 4 pm and 8 am.
